title: Every renderer a criterion names needs its own test of the new prop
rule: When a criterion lists several components that must show a new thing (every specimen renderer, every list view), give each listed component a test that mounts it and asserts the thing, with one case where it shows and one where it must not. A test of the shared child component or of one parent does not count for the others: dropping or misbinding the prop in an untested parent leaves the whole suite green.
rationale: E43.4 (#468): Quick Look and the family style rows passed the tofu list to SpecimenText, but no test mounted them, so removing the binding would not have failed any test.
